functions.name: reanimator.bake_to_rig
functions.description: Bake animation from skeleton to rig.

frag_rig.description: Target rig. If None, uses first rig from selection.

start_frame.description: Start frame for baking. If None, uses animation range.

end_frame.description: End frame for baking. If None, uses animation range.

append.description: If True, appends animation after existing animation on rig.

motion_encode.description: If True, aligns root motion when appending.

functions.name: reanimator.bake_to_rig_from_different_skeleton
functions.description: Retarget animation from a different character's skeleton to a rig.

frag_rig.description: Target rig. If None, uses first rig from selection.

source_asset_name.description: Name of source asset to get skeleton from. If None and skel_root not provided, will prompt user.

start_frame.description: Start frame for baking. If None, uses animation range.

end_frame.description: End frame for baking. If None, uses animation range.

append.description: If True, appends animation after existing animation on rig.

motion_encode.description: If True, aligns root motion when appending.

functions.name: reanimator.bake_to_skeleton
functions.description: Bake animation from rig to skeleton.

frag_rig.description: Source rig. If None, uses first rig from selection.

start_frame.description: Start frame for baking. If None, uses animation range.

end_frame.description: End frame for baking. If None, uses animation range.

set_to_zero.description: If True, shifts animation to start at frame 0.

functions.name: reanimator.get_selected_rig_and_skeleton
functions.description: Get the first FRAG rig and skeleton root from current selection.

functions.name: reanimator.get_selected_rigs
functions.description: Get all FRAG rigs from current selection.

functions.name: reanimator.reload_rig
functions.description: Reload/reimport a rig while preserving animation.

frag_rig.description: Rig to reload. If None, reloads all selected rigs.
